The *Hetuduka, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 9.2) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. It constitutes a section within the combinatory system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, specifically joining the Root Dyad (*hetuduka*) with the Feeling Triad (*vedanāttika*) immediately after the Root Dyad's combination with the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) [Nyanatiloka 1938]. In this analytical framework, the dyads (commencing with root conditions) are systematically cross-tabulated with all twenty-two triads of the Abhidhamma matrix, establishing the permutations of conditional relations across doctrinal categories [Nyanatiloka 1938].
No extant parallels in other languages are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis by DharmaNexus reflects the formulaic and recurring nature of the *Paṭṭhāna*, showing 198 internal text-reuse passages shared with 44 other Pali texts, but no cross-language alignments [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual parallels occur within related combinatorial sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, primarily *Hetuduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.1; 25 matches), *Hetuduka, Duka* (Patthana 6.1; 22 matches), and parallel dyad-triad treatments such as *Hetuduka, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 15.2; 7 matches) and *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 1.3 and 13.2) [DharmaNexus].
